name: Oratoire Saint-Joseph

elevation.datum: Peregrine flat ground = 0; not a geodetic elevation
elevation.published: Oratory states outer dome 155 m above Queen Mary Road and 263 m above sea level, exterior height 97 m. No named geodetic vertical datum; do not use 263 as model height.
elevation.approximation: Local rise compressed to 24 m, from implied roughly 58 m (155 minus 97); solid supports stay within building/pedestrian axis. Access roads retain provider height.

note: Original texture-free procedural exterior. Roof, crypt, stairs and decorative details simplified; no survey accuracy or third-party geometry.
